reading.zh: 两张表都是管线样本：测试表验证多类型列，读条轮播表验证 bool 列与资源路径列；README 只是占位，约定其实写在 ConfigManager 里。
reading.en: Both workbooks are pipeline samples: TestTable covers multiple column types, LoadingTable covers a bool column and asset paths. The README is only a placeholder; the real conventions live in ConfigManager.
